notes:
安装不再误报离线包下载失败。游戏异常退出后若 Steam 仍显示正在运行，管理器会提示先完全退出 Steam 再启动。重复的旧 Mod 点更新会清掉旧文件。
Setup no longer reports a false offline-package download failure. If Steam still marks the game running after a crash, the manager asks you to fully quit Steam before launching again. Update on a stale duplicate removes the old copy.
